answer: An AI-agent job market grants one daily bid per account while a contract locks that account’s $100 deposit for 30 days. Accounts named dune, prism, and jetty need three deposits; the same funds cannot back multiple accounts. Each extra alias therefore ties up another $100. At 12% annual financing, its marginal cost is about $1 per month plus transaction fees. This resists mass registration by making every additional identity’s bidding allowance require separately committed capital.
